entries.name: Overall composition
entries.condition: still.png vs reference_a.png composition targets in reference_a.json
entries.evidence: horizon 0.247 vs 0.250 and cloud cover 0.37 vs 0.39 match, but water area fraction is 0.54 vs 0.31, bridge end lands at [0.668,0.376] vs [0.735,0.325] (0.084 displacement) and the aircraft bbox IoU is only 0.76 because the plane sits 0.03 higher than the reference.
entries.defect: The mid-ground A4-C5 and F4-H5 that the reference fills with wooded islands and a second landmass is open cyan water, so the frame reads as one island in an empty lagoon rather than the reference's layered archipelago.
entries.fix: Add two or three low mangrove/wooded islands with sand rims in A4-C5 and F5-G5, rotate the main bridge end 6 deg further right so its far abutment projects at ~[0.73,0.33], and lower the aircraft 30 px.

entries.name: Aircraft silhouette
entries.condition: still.png aircraft outline against water at native resolution and crops/aircraft.png
entries.evidence: High-wing floatplane silhouette with correct wing span-to-fuselage ratio, twin floats with spreader bars, fin and rudder visible above wing, prop disc; outline stays stable over clip frames 0/1/10/20/29.
entries.defect: The horizontal stabiliser is fully hidden by the wing at this pose so the tail reads as a lone fin, and the wing tips are cut square with no rounding, which reads slightly boxy against the rounded Beaver reference.
entries.fix: Round the wing-tip planform by ~0.3 m radius and lower the tailplane 0.2 m so its tips show past the wing trailing edge from above.

entries.name: Aircraft geometry
entries.condition: crops/aircraft.png (324 px crop) and still crop 1250-1780 x 620-920
entries.evidence: Struts from wing to fuselage, float N-struts, spreader bars, cowl ring and hub are present and meet their parents; no floating or intersecting parts visible at 2x zoom.
entries.defect: Wing struts are single thin cylinders with no fairing and the float step/keel is a plain rounded box; the fuselage roof has no fuel-cap, antenna or panel breaks.
entries.fix: Add streamlined strut fairings, a float step notch and keel edge, and a roof antenna plus door outlines to the fuselage mesh.

entries.name: Aircraft scale
entries.condition: projected aircraft width vs reference and vs boats/island scale
entries.evidence: Projected model box width 0.228 vs reference 0.232 (0.004 diff); the plane spans about 1.4 times the F8 speedboat length at similar depth, consistent with a 14.6 m wingspan versus a 8 m boat.
entries.defect: No scale error found that needs less than focused inspection; the plane sits ~0.025 too high in frame which slightly enlarges it relative to the island behind.
entries.fix: Move the chase camera 30 px worth of pitch so the plane centroid returns to [0.77,0.74].

entries.name: Aircraft materials
entries.condition: crops/aircraft.png specular highlight roll-off across fuselage, wing and floats under high sun
entries.evidence: White paint shows a soft highlight on the fuselage roof and cowl, the yellow trim keeps its saturation in shade (220,206,99 vs ref 239,199,90, dE 11.7); floats show a graded highlight along their top.
entries.defect: The white wing upper surface is a single flat tone from root to tip with no anisotropic sheen, rivet lines or dirt break-up, and the yellow trim is too green (b* low) compared with the reference's warm yellow.
entries.fix: Add a subtle 0.35-0.5 roughness variation mask (panel lines, walkway grit near the root) to the wing and shift the trim albedo to sRGB (239,199,90).

entries.name: Cockpit and glass
entries.condition: crops/aircraft.png cabin glazing: interior visibility, tint, fresnel and sky reflection
entries.evidence: Cabin windows are transparent, seats and instrument panel are visible, glass is sorted correctly against the fuselage and no flicker across clip frames.
entries.defect: Glass shows no sky/cloud reflection or fresnel brightening at grazing angle from this above-rear view; it reads as a dark tinted acrylic slab with 100 percent interior visibility.
entries.fix: Add environment-probe reflection with fresnel (F0 0.04, roughness 0.05) so the windscreen picks up the white clouds in E1-F2 and dims the interior at grazing angles.

entries.name: Buildings and skyline
entries.evidence: Downtown cluster has 12 named landmark towers with varied heights and pastel facades; a second cluster at G3-H3 reads as a barrier-island city.
entries.defect: Every tower is a flat-shaded box with no window rows, setbacks or rooftop plant at this distance, the low-rise carpet A3-C3 is a uniform cream field with no street grid or shadow texture, and the G3 cluster's buildings are all the same pastel-slab shape.
entries.fix: Add a windowed facade texture with per-floor bands and a roof detail atlas at LOD1, and give the low-rise carpet a street-grid albedo plus AO so it breaks into blocks.

entries.name: Terrain and coastlines
entries.condition: still crop 300-1100 x 560-1000 and 0-450 x 600-1000: beach tone, shore edge, shoal gradient
entries.evidence: Shallow-water gradient from cream to cyan around the island with visible submerged sand shoals in A7-B8, an irregular coastline and a lagoon; sand mean (212,203,181) is brighter than reference (184,167,148), dE 12.9.
entries.defect: Beaches are over-bright and desaturated so they read as bleached paper, and the sand meets the water with a uniform thin white foam rim of constant width around the whole island (C8-E8).
entries.fix: Lower sand albedo to about (190,172,150), add wet-sand darkening 3-5 m from the waterline and vary the foam rim width with wave phase.

entries.name: Water color and depth
entries.condition: still: near/far water colour vs reference dominant colours, depth cue variation
entries.evidence: waterNear (59,149,177) vs ref (80,148,171) dE 4.7 and waterFar (105,152,180) dE 4.6; deep channel under the bridge is darker blue than the shallows and cloud shadows darken patches in F7-G8.
entries.defect: The mid-lagoon E5-H6 is one saturated cyan with no depth banding or sandbar tonality between the 2 m shoals and 15 m channel; cloud-shadow patches are soft blobs with no definite edge.
entries.fix: Drive water colour from a depth texture with at least three bands and sharpen cloud-shadow projection using the actual cloud silhouette.

entries.name: Water reflections
entries.condition: still and clip: sky, cloud and object reflections on the water surface
entries.evidence: Reflection pass renders 69 calls / 198k triangles, but at this 12 deg pitch there is no visible reflection of the E1-F2 clouds, the bridge towers or the aircraft on the water; only a diffuse cyan tone.
entries.defect: The water reads as a diffuse coloured surface with no sky reflection component, unlike the reference where the lagoon carries pale sky reflection towards the horizon.
entries.fix: Blend the planar reflection with a fresnel term so that at grazing angles the far water picks up sky and cloud colour, and ensure the reflection is not fully attenuated by the shallow-water tint.

entries.name: Boat wakes and water interaction
entries.condition: still crop 1150-1750 x 850-1080 and clip frames 0-29: wake shape, foam, spreading
entries.evidence: Speedboat at F8 trails a single white line ~2 px wide and 250 px long with no V spread; the G6 wake is a fainter straight line; no bow wave or hull foam is visible.
entries.defect: Wakes are straight constant-width streaks instead of the reference's diverging V with Kelvin arms and turbulent foam that fades with distance.
entries.fix: Replace the wake ribbon with a Kelvin-angle (19.5 deg) V mesh plus a fading turbulent centre band whose width grows with distance behind the hull.

entries.name: Vegetation
entries.condition: still crop 300-1100 x 560-1000 and crops/environment.png: canopy shape, colour variation, palms
entries.evidence: Canopies are rounded lumpy spheres in 3-4 greens with sun shading and soft ground shadow; palms appear as small dark starburst shapes on the sand.
entries.defect: All broadleaf trees share the same lumpy-sphere canopy silhouette at the same height so the island reads as broccoli, and palms have no visible trunks or fronds at 380 m.
entries.fix: Add at least three canopy silhouette variants with 30 percent height variance and give palms an 8 m trunk with a frond crown card so they read from altitude.

entries.name: Bridge and infrastructure accuracy
entries.condition: still crop 1080-1300 x 380-500 at 4x and 0-420 x 660-760 at 3x: piers, towers, deck profile, cables
entries.evidence: Suspension towers stand in the water, cable fans are attached to both deck sides, approach piers on the causeway meet the water, and cars travel on the causeway deck.
entries.defect: The main-span deck rises to the towers with an abrupt kink (visible gradient change at E4 over ~10 px) instead of a smooth camber, and the causeway deck surface has no lane markings or barrier shadow.
entries.fix: Spline the deck profile so the rise from approach to main span is continuous, and add a lane-marking albedo and a barrier shadow strip to the causeway deck.

entries.name: Cloud volume
entries.condition: still crop 0-1920 x 0-260: cumulus form, lit/shade gradient, base, edge softness
entries.evidence: Cumulus have cauliflower tops with a lit top and a grey flat base, edges are soft and cloud colour (219,217,216) matches the reference (219,218,216).
entries.defect: Cloud bases are perfectly flat horizontal planes at one altitude and each cloud is a cluster of near-identical puff spheres; no thin high stratus layer like the reference's horizon streaks.
entries.fix: Vary base altitude by +/-60 m per cloud, add a thin cirrus layer near the horizon and break up the puff primitives with noise erosion.

entries.name: Atmospheric perspective
entries.condition: still: haze gradient from horizon to mid-ground, distant desaturation
entries.evidence: The far skyline and G3 city are desaturated and lifted toward the sky colour, the horizon sits under a pale haze band.
entries.defect: The haze band at the horizon is a uniform grey ribbon (A3-H3) with a visible tonal step to the blue sky above it rather than a smooth exponential gradient.
entries.fix: Use a height-fog exponential with a softer falloff above the horizon and tint the haze slightly warm to blend into the sky gradient.

entries.name: Sunlight and exposure
entries.condition: still: highlight roll-off on the plane, sand exposure, sun direction consistency
entries.evidence: Sun is high from behind-left as in the reference; plane highlights and shadows agree with the tree shadows on the island.
entries.defect: Sand at C7-D8 is near-clipping at (212,203,181) and beach detail is lost; the reference keeps sand at (184,167,148) with visible texture.
entries.fix: Reduce exposure by 0.3 EV or lower the sand albedo so the beach sits mid-tone with visible grain.

entries.name: Shadow quality
entries.condition: still: tree, bridge and cloud shadow presence, contact and softness
entries.evidence: Trees cast soft contact shadows on the sand; cloud shadows appear as dark patches on the water at F7-G8.
entries.defect: The suspension bridge and its towers cast no visible shadow on the water at D4-F4 despite high sun, and cloud shadows are soft ellipses that do not match the cloud shapes above.
entries.fix: Include the bridge in the shadow cascades at this distance and project cloud shadows from the actual cloud density texture.

entries.name: Reflections and specular response
entries.condition: still: sun glitter on water, specular on plane, wet surfaces
entries.evidence: Faint sparkle on the water at F5-H6 and a soft highlight on the plane cowl.
entries.defect: Sun glitter is uniformly faint across the whole lagoon with no anisotropic streak toward the sun, and the water specular does not respond to the wave shape.
entries.fix: Add a GGX-based sun specular with roughness driven by the wave normal map so glitter concentrates in a streak.

entries.name: Color grading
entries.condition: still: overall palette vs reference dominant colours
entries.evidence: Water and cloud colours match within dE 5; sky top (148,165,181) is far paler than the reference (55,134,180), dE 25.9, and the sky-horizon is bluer than the reference.
entries.defect: The sky gradient is inverted in saturation relative to the reference: saturated near the horizon and washed at the top, producing a hazy over-bright top half.
entries.fix: Rebalance the sky gradient so zenith is (55,134,180) and horizon (107,160,184) at this sun elevation.

entries.name: Motion and temporal stability
entries.evidence: Mean abs difference 3.4-3.9 between adjacent frames, all attributable to camera translation; no LOD popping of trees or bridge, no shimmer on cables at 2x crop.
entries.defect: The plane's bank angle changes visibly between frames 0 and 10 while the camera stays fixed, producing a slight rock; canopy edges soften slightly frame to frame from TAA.
entries.fix: Damp the roll controller in the bench flight so the bench pose holds within 2 deg, and tighten TAA history weighting on foliage.

entries.name: Flight physics and camera behavior
entries.condition: metrics telemetry: airspeed 52.5-53.6 m/s, altitude 382-384 m, heading 200 to 192 deg over the clip, alpha 0.01-0.04
entries.evidence: Plane holds altitude within 2 m and airspeed within 1 m/s while turning 8 deg over 30 frames; the pose in flight.png shows a gentle right bank consistent with the heading change.
entries.defect: The chase camera is locked to the same quaternion in still and flight so the plane rotates within the frame rather than the camera following the bank, making the plane appear to pivot around the camera.
entries.fix: Add a camera roll follow of 30 percent of the bank angle with 0.5 s smoothing.

entries.name: Object density and world believability
entries.condition: still: count of boats, cars, piers, secondary islands vs reference
entries.evidence: Two moving boats with wakes, a ferry near the H4 city, cars on the causeway, a pier at D5; the reference has at least 8 boats, marina activity and many islands.
entries.defect: The lagoon E5-H6 is empty of traffic and moorings; the reference frame is dense with wakes, moored boats and small islets.
entries.fix: Add 6-8 boats along the channel with wakes, two anchored yachts near the island, and mooring buoys near the pier.

entries.name: Detail consistency across distance
entries.condition: still: near island detail vs far island and skyline detail
entries.evidence: Near island trees are individually shaded; far islands at D3-F3 are dark green strips with a sand rim; far city carpet is flat cream.
entries.defect: The transition from individual trees to strip islands has no intermediate stage, and the far low-rise carpet has no texture so distance detail drops off sharply.
entries.fix: Add a mid-distance canopy card LOD and a textured low-rise city imposter.

entries.name: Lack of repetition
entries.condition: still: repeated canopy shapes, building slabs, cloud puffs
entries.evidence: Canopies share the same lumpy-sphere silhouette; the G3 city is a set of identical slab widths; cloud puffs repeat the same sphere size.
entries.defect: Repetition of the single canopy mesh is visible across the whole island without focused inspection.
entries.fix: Add mesh variants and per-instance scale/rotation jitter for trees and slab-width variation for the city.

entries.name: Lack of visual artifacts
entries.condition: still and clip at 2x-4x zoom: aliasing on cables, canopy edges, horizon seam, tiling
entries.evidence: No hard horizon seam, no water tiling visible, cable fans are anti-aliased; canopy edges show slight stair-step at 4x only.
entries.defect: The cable fans render as semi-transparent grey triangular sheets at this distance rather than individual lines, which is a minor read as a solid plane.
entries.fix: Fade the cable sheet alpha with distance so it thins to individual bright lines rather than a translucent plane.

entries.name: UI readability
entries.condition: still: HUD legibility, occlusion of the reference composition
entries.evidence: KIAS/ALT/V-S, THR/FUEL cards are legible at 3x zoom with high contrast, occupy under 4 percent of frame and do not cover the aircraft or the island.
entries.defect: The top-centre timer card sits inside the E1 cloud and the bottom-left build string overlays the shoal detail; fonts at 1080p are 11 px tall which needs focus to read.
entries.fix: Move the timer to the bottom edge and increase HUD text to 14 px.

entries.name: FPS and frame-time stability
entries.condition: metrics.json clip frameTimesMs and still/flight metrics
entries.evidence: Clip frame times 6.3-11.2 ms (all under 16.7 ms); 271 draw calls, 1.04 M triangles; flight avgFps 78.6 but p99 66.5 ms and one long task during still warmup.
entries.defect: A single 66.5 ms spike during warmup and a long task indicate a shader-compile or streaming hitch at scene start.
entries.fix: Pre-compile shader variants and pre-upload textures before the first rendered frame.

entries.condition: still: panel, gauge, hand and prop-disc size vs 62 deg fov

entries.fix: Scale the hand/arm meshes to 0.65 and move the yoke 8 cm forward.

entries.name: Aircraft materials
entries.condition: still and crops/distant.png: headliner, panel, yoke and skin material response
entries.evidence: Panel is a matte dark plastic with placards and legible gauge faces; the headliner shows a quilted fabric normal map.
entries.defect: Headliner quilting tiles visibly every ~90 px across A1-H2 (crops/distant.png), the yoke and arms are a single flat grey and flat blue with no specular, and the skin is one flat orange tone.
entries.fix: Use a non-repeating headliner texture with a 2 m tile break-up, add a semi-gloss plastic response to the yoke and a subsurface-tinted skin material.

entries.name: Cockpit and glass
entries.condition: still: windscreen and side glass presence (reflection, fresnel, dirt, frame) and gauge glass
entries.evidence: Exterior is rendered with no attenuation, tint, reflection or specular through any window; the gauge faces have no glass highlight.
entries.defect: The windscreen is effectively absent: no cockpit-interior reflection, no sky fresnel, no scratches or dust, and the prop-disc arc sits as a translucent brown ring in front of a glass that shows nothing.
entries.fix: Add a windscreen mesh with a low-roughness glass material sampling an interior cubemap at fresnel weight 0.04-0.1 plus a subtle dust/scratch mask, and add a curved glass highlight to each gauge bezel.

entries.name: Buildings and skyline
entries.condition: still crop 500-1300 x 540-700 at 2x and 0-450 x 540-900 at 2x
entries.evidence: Downtown at D5-F5 has around 25 towers of varied height and hue; the suburb A5-B6 is a field of pastel boxes with roads.
entries.defect: Towers are un-windowed flat slabs with no ground-plane connection detail, the suburb houses are identical pastel boxes with flat roofs on a cream plane and the low-rise carpet behind them is a texture-less cream field.
entries.fix: Add windowed facade atlases and roof detail to the tower LOD, model pitched-roof house variants and give the ground a block-and-street albedo.

entries.name: Terrain and coastlines
entries.condition: still crop 0-450 x 540-900 at 2x: beach, ground, coastline profile
entries.evidence: A thin sand strip meets cyan water along a nearly straight shoreline; ground is a flat cream plane.
entries.defect: The suburb ground has no grass, lots, driveways or elevation and the beach is a uniform 12 px strip with no dune line or wet-sand edge.
entries.fix: Add a lot/grass albedo layer under the suburb and a two-tone beach profile with a wet-sand band and slight dune ridge.

entries.name: Water color and depth
entries.condition: still: near vs far water colour and depth cues
entries.evidence: Near water is saturated cyan with darker cloud-shadow patches; far water at G5-H5 lifts toward the sky colour and darkens in the channel beyond the islands.
entries.defect: Near water at A7-B8 has no depth gradient to the beach (same cyan 2 m and 10 m out) and the cloud shadows are smooth blobs.
entries.fix: Feed the shoreline depth into the water absorption so the first 30 m from the beach shift toward the sand colour.

entries.name: Water reflections
entries.condition: still crop 1300-1920 x 380-720 at 2x: sky reflection on far water at grazing angle
entries.evidence: Far water carries a pale sky tone at the horizon which is correct for grazing angles; no cloud shapes are mirrored.
entries.defect: The cumulus at G4-H4 have no reflection footprint on the water below them and the water-sky boundary is a single sharp line with a slightly brighter band above.
entries.fix: Blend the planar reflection into the far water with a fresnel curve so cloud shapes are mirrored and the horizon line softens.

entries.name: Boat wakes and water interaction
entries.condition: still: shoreline surf, boat wakes, water-object contact
entries.evidence: No boats or wakes are visible anywhere in this bay view and the shoreline at A6-B7 meets the water with no surf or foam line.
entries.defect: A city bay with zero surface traffic and a foam-less shoreline reads as a static texture.
entries.fix: Spawn 3-5 boats with wakes in the bay in front of the city and add a shoreline foam band driven by shore distance.

entries.name: Vegetation
entries.condition: still crop 0-450 x 540-900 at 2x: tree form and distribution in the suburb
entries.evidence: Trees are scattered among the houses in two green tones and follow lots loosely.
entries.defect: Every tree is the same sphere-blob at the same height and the far carpet turns into a speckle of identical dots with no palms or street trees.
entries.fix: Add palm and canopy variants with height jitter and a mid-distance tree card LOD.

entries.condition: still: roads, causeways, infrastructure visible from the cabin
entries.evidence: Suburb roads form a grid of pale lines that terminate at the beach; the barrier island at H5 shows a road along its length.

entries.name: Cloud volume
entries.condition: still crop 1300-1920 x 380-720 at 2x and 1100-1920 x 120-480: cloud form, lighting
entries.evidence: Cumulus have lit tops, soft edges and a grey base, and are correctly occluded by the overhead panel geometry.

entries.fix: Randomise the puff arrangement and base altitude per cloud instance.

entries.name: Atmospheric perspective
entries.condition: still: distance desaturation of skyline and far ground, horizon haze
entries.evidence: The far carpet at A5 fades to pale cream and the skyline lifts toward the sky tone; the sea horizon has a soft haze band.
entries.defect: The haze forms a discrete lighter band ~20 px above the horizon at F5-H5 rather than a continuous gradient.
entries.fix: Extend the height-fog falloff so the horizon band blends over at least 80 px.

entries.evidence: Blue water with ripple and the wing shadow reading correctly under the plane.
entries.defect: The water beside the floats is opaque with no sand-bottom visibility at 2 m depth and 4 m range.
entries.fix: Add refraction with a bottom texture.

entries.name: Water reflections
entries.condition: still crop 700-1920 x 700-1080 at 0.7x; reflection pass 72 calls / 207 k triangles
entries.evidence: A pale reflection band of the float hulls appears in the water.
entries.defect: The yellow fuselage and white roof 2 m above the water have no visible reflection, and the reflection of the floats is a blur band.
entries.fix: Include the fuselage in the reflection layer and reduce blur.

entries.name: Boat wakes and water interaction
entries.condition: floats crop; clip frames; wake pass 3352-4402 triangles
entries.evidence: Floats sit at a plausible waterline.
entries.defect: No waterline foam, meniscus or bow ripple at 3.5 m/s, 4 m from the camera.
entries.fix: Foam waterline strip and a low-speed wake.

entries.name: Vegetation
entries.condition: still crops at 2x
entries.evidence: A tree line along the far shore.
entries.defect: Trees are sprites at 3 km; no vegetation nearer than the mainland so nothing to judge in a close-up frame.
entries.fix: Place a mangrove island within 300 m of the fixed camera.

entries.name: Bridge and infrastructure accuracy
entries.condition: still crop 0-650 x 100-320 at 2x
entries.evidence: Cable-stayed bridge with pylon and fan cables and a causeway on visible piers behind the wing; a green channel marker at G3-H3.
entries.defect: Cables are 1 px, the deck has no railing or lamps.
entries.fix: 2 px cable quads and deck furniture.

entries.name: Cloud volume
entries.condition: still: cumulus band along the top
entries.evidence: Cumulus with lit tops and shaded bases.
entries.defect: Clouds are cropped by the top edge and the HUD cards; puffs share one sprite.
entries.fix: Sprite variants.

entries.name: Atmospheric perspective
entries.condition: pixel samples: horizon rows 270-281 at column 1100 vary (98-110,117-128,137-145)
entries.evidence: The far skyline is hazed and desaturated relative to the plane.
entries.defect: The sea/sky junction is a hard line across the frame.
entries.fix: Horizon fog blend.

entries.name: Sunlight and exposure
entries.condition: still: white roof (199,199,198), white side (207,206,203), yellow shade (108,92,31)
entries.evidence: The 15:30 sun from the far side puts the visible flank in shade with a lit roof edge; exposure holds the roof.
entries.defect: The shaded flank is lit by a flat ambient so the white side (207) is brighter than the sunlit roof (199), inverting the light direction; the yellow in shade collapses to olive (108,92,31).
entries.fix: Use a hemispherical ambient with a ground-bounce term and raise the sun so the roof reads brighter than the flank.

entries.name: Shadow quality
entries.condition: still: wing shadow on the water; shadow pass 68 calls / 221 k triangles
entries.evidence: The wing and fuselage shadow falls on the water beyond the floats in the correct direction; the strut casts a line on the fuselage.
entries.defect: No contact shadow or occlusion where the struts meet the fuselage or where the float truss meets the float decks; the water shadow is a flat slab.
entries.fix: Add SSAO and modulate the water shadow by the normal.

entries.name: Reflections and specular response
entries.condition: specular scan of the glass-sun view
entries.evidence: A soft horizontal reflection streak on the windscreen and a mild roof highlight.
entries.defect: The view is built to show sun on glass and there is no sun glint, no Fresnel rim on the panes, no specular on the riveted white skin; the glass reads as tinted plastic.
entries.fix: GGX sun lobe with Fresnel on glass and a clearcoat on the paint.

entries.name: Color grading
entries.condition: pixel samples above
entries.evidence: Yellow/white/navy livery against blue water and sky with pastel skyline: coherent.
entries.defect: The shaded yellow goes olive-brown and the cheat stripe loses saturation, so the flank looks dirty rather than shaded.
entries.fix: Preserve chroma in shadow via the ambient colour.

entries.name: Motion and temporal stability
entries.condition: 30 clip frames: flicker meanAbsDiff 1.20, maxAbsDiff 1.64; frames 0,7,14,21,29
entries.evidence: Fixed camera, slow taxi, no popping; interior and glass stable.
entries.defect: Frames 28-29 show the highest diff (2.49) as the skyline's 1 px window grid slides behind the fin.
entries.fix: Anisotropic filtering on facade textures.

entries.name: Flight physics and camera behavior
entries.condition: still vs flight.png; telemetry airspeed 3.5 -> 3.43 m/s, heading 240 -> 242.8, onWater
entries.evidence: Slow taxi with a small heading drift; HUD consistent.
entries.defect: No buoyancy pitch/roll over 90 frames and no water-rudder animation.
entries.fix: Add buoyancy oscillation and rudder animation.

entries.name: Object density and world believability
entries.condition: still: object count
entries.evidence: Bridge, causeway, skyline, cranes, channel marker.
entries.defect: Nothing within 2 km of the camera except the plane; the cabin interior has no cargo, headsets on hooks or charts to sell the air-taxi story.
entries.fix: Add interior props and a near dock or buoy.

entries.name: Detail consistency across distance
entries.cells: C3-F5 vs D3-D4 pilot vs F2-H3
entries.condition: still: near detail
entries.evidence: Rivets and decals at 4 m are at the right frequency.
entries.defect: The pilot 4 m away is a featureless orange sphere with a headset ring and box seats, well below the detail level of the rivets around him.
entries.fix: Add a pilot model with face, hands and headset geometry and seat cushions with stitching.

entries.name: Lack of repetition
entries.condition: repetition scan
entries.evidence: Rivet spacing and panel lines are regular as they should be.
entries.defect: The skyline window grid repeats one texture across all towers.
entries.fix: Facade variants.

entries.name: Lack of visual artifacts
entries.cells: A6-C7 facets, F3-F4 rear window, D7 belly box, A2-H3 horizon
entries.condition: artifact scan of every cell in still_grid and clip frames
entries.evidence: Fuselage faceting; an opaque rear window next to transparent ones; an unfaired belly box; hard horizon.
entries.defect: Faceting and the mismatched window are visible in ordinary play on a close-up; no hard-failure artifact.
entries.fix: Smooth normals, unify glass, fair the box, fog the horizon.

entries.name: UI readability
entries.condition: still: HUD cards
entries.evidence: Cards legible; FIXED and time labels present.
entries.defect: Cards cover cumulus at A1 and H1; no ticks on the throttle bar.
entries.fix: Bottom bar layout.

entries.name: FPS and frame-time stability
entries.condition: metrics.json: clip frame times 4.3-8.4 ms, 0 of 30 over 11 ms; still 757 k triangles, 266 calls
entries.evidence: Tightest frame-time spread in the set.
entries.defect: 266 draw calls for a close-up where the background could be batched.
entries.fix: Batch skyline meshes.

worst3: No sun glint, Fresnel rim or specular on the glass in the view built to show it (C3-F5)
Shaded flank brighter than the sunlit roof and the yellow collapsing to olive (A3-C7)
Featureless sphere-headed pilot behind riveted, decaled panels (D3-D4)
best3: Transparent windscreen and door panes with riveted frames and a soft reflection streak (C3-E5)
Riveted panel lines and crisp Bahia Vista Air Taxi decal along the fuselage (A5-F6)
Tightest frame times in the set (4.3-8.4 ms) with lowest flicker
